traps: two package managers declare the same libraries for one target, and they disagree: vcpkg builds fmt 10.1.1, Conan fmt 10.2.1; which one is used depends on the toolchain file passed to CMake
vcpkg's fmt has no version constraint, so the builtin-baseline would give 10.2.1, but the override pins 10.1.1 even though it is lower
zlib under vcpkg resolves from the baseline commit 01f602195983451bc83e72f4214af2cbc495aa94 (zlib 1.3.1 there); vcpkg has no lockfile, the baseline is the lock
conan.lock pins recipe revisions (after #) with a timestamp (after %): the version is the part before #
cmake/3.28.1 is a tool_requires: a build tool Conan downloads, not a library linked into imgtool, and it differs from cmake_minimum_required 3.24
the vcpkg.json name imgtool is the manifest's own name, not a dependency
fmt::fmt and ZLIB::ZLIB are imported targets from find_package, not units of this project
